title: LightGBM flow model: what it is and what it is not

items.label: Trained on
items.text: Header-only CTU-13-Extended captures (5 scenarios): 31,665 malicious and 83,035 benign flows.

items.label: Validated by
items.text: Leave one CTU-13 scenario out: every score comes from a model that never saw that capture.

items.label: Alert budget
items.text: Threshold set for 1 ML-only false positive per 10,000 benign flows.
facts: 1 ML-only false positive per 10,000 benign flows

items.label: Held-out result
items.text: PR-AUC 0.9704, but recall at the budget only 0.2818 (pooled, scenario held out). s6 DonBot and s11 Rbot get 0 recall held out.
facts: s6 DonBot and s11 Rbot get 0 recall held out

items.label: Cannot see
items.text: They never see DNS names, TLS fingerprints or payload. DGA, DNS tunnel and encrypted-session alerts come from the rules.
facts: They never see DNS names, TLS fingerprints or payload

items.label: Guard rails
items.text: ML-only alerts are capped at MEDIUM. The IsolationForest corroborates only; it never alerts alone.
facts: ML-only alerts are capped at MEDIUM

items.label: Known failure modes
items.text: Unanswered TCP connections look malicious. Training traffic is a 2011 university network.
facts: Training traffic is a 2011 university network
